subject: reasoning
question: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only one person is sitting between C and D (when counted from one side only). B is sitting second to the left of D. A is sitting to the immediate right of B. Who is sitting on the immediate right of C?
solution:
Given: Five persons A, B, C, D and E.

1) Only one person is sitting between C and D (when counted from one side only).

2) B is sitting second to the left of D.

3) A is sitting to the immediate right of B.
